title: Kunai
extract:
The Kunai are a set of throwing knives, released in Update 8.0 (2013-05-23). It deals a significant amount of damage, but can be hard to aim with because of its arrow-like arc projection.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000; it is also a weapon crafting ingredient for  Tipedo.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Can hit multiple enemies in a short line (caused by flying dead bodies and not by the Kunai).
Can use the Kunai-exclusive  Stockpiled Blight augment.
Has two  polarity.

The arc of the shots enable headshots over cover.

Acquisition
The Kunai's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Notes
The Kunai does not have the pinning properties of other projectile weapons, such as the  Boltor or  Paris, but will simply throw targets backwards upon death.

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Kunai Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Kunai with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Kunai Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Yao Shrubs, and 80  Eevani.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving weakpoint hits and then pressing the Alternate Fire button. 4 weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
Charges do not generate on the backpacks of most MOA variants, or vulnerability spots generated by  Sonar or  Detect Vulnerability in places other than actual weakpoints.
Weakpoints on corpses or Invulnerable targets do not build charges.
Individual Multishot bullets can build charges.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.
Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Kunai's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 5 rounds to a maximum of 20. Once all ammunition is expended, the Kunai reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as  Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.

Evolutions

Tips
Make sure to adjust your aim for moving targets.
When using at a distance, aim above the enemy to adjust for the arc of the blades.
Using the  Pistol Ammo Mutation mod can help regain lost ammo when needed.
Alternatively, bring along Squad Ammo Restores.
The Kunai's throwing arc means you can sometimes aim at targets behind cover. Aiming slightly above the cover will result in the Kunai curving downwards onto the target.
Note that this is extremely situational, as enemy cover is usually too high to take advantage of this.

Trivia
The Kunai (苦無) were traditionally a multipurpose tool, similar in design to a crowbar or trowel. It could be used for gardening, masonry, and other things. Popular culture has since associated the kunai with ninjas.
The  Despair and  Hikou share similarities to the Kunai, they are all thrown secondaries that deal mostly  Puncture damage.
Update 16.7 (2015-06-04) revealed the Kunai to be a themed-weapon based off the  Paris, in the same manner that other themed-weapons like the  Akjagara,  Aksomati, and  Bolto are related to the  Tigris,  Soma, and  Boltor respectively.
